jobPostingInfo.title: Cloud Engineer (Advisor)
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Playing an essential role in the U.S. economy, Fannie Mae is foundational to housing finance. Here, your expertise can help fuel purpose-driven innovation that expands access to homeownership and affordable rental housing across the country. Join Fannie Mae to grow your career and help people find a place to call home.

Job Description

As a valued contributor to our team, you will design and develop unprecedented solutions for Cloud Engineering, solving complex or unusual business problems across several projects, programs, or products. This work includes architecture, design, coding, testing, and certifying technology platforms, software, and applications. 
 
THE IMPACT YOU WILL MAKE 
 

The Cloud Engineer - Advisor ideal candidate brings extensive experience in team building, collaboration, and facilitation of Cloud engineering in a large, multinational Fortune 500 enterprise. This individual will possess extensive experience in secure, scalable cloud infrastructure, with proven leadership capabilities. In this role, they will manage large-scale public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).  

The  role will afford you the opportunity to work as an individual contributor, while partnering with peers at the Manager and Senior Manager levels. The responsibilities include: 

  • Develop and execute strategic cloud infrastructure plans and drive best practices    

  • Design and implement cloud strategies and architectures.   

  • Build robust and modern solutions with hands-on coding  

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.  

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align cloud solutions with business goals.  

  • Stay current with cloud technologies and industry trends.  

  • Develop technical documentation and executive-level presentations.  

  • Mentor junior engineers.  

  • Ensure integration of cloud solutions with existing systems.  

  • Identify and mitigate risks; troubleshoot complex issues.  

  • Advocate for cloud best practices and standards.   


Qualifications 


THE EXPERIENCE YOU BRING TO THE TEAM 
 
Minimum Required Experiences 

  • 6 years of hands-on experience engineering cloud platforms 
  • Shows curiosity and adaptability in learning and responsibly applying new technologies, including artificial intelligence, to reimagine how we work.

 
Desired Experiences 

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent 
  • Cloud Certifications 
  • Experience working in mission-critical environments 

 

Technical Skills 

  • Skilled in engineering resilient, highly available cloud solutions in secure multi-cloud environments e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP 
  • Deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure, network architecture, security, and identity management.  
  • Experience in building cloud environments (accounts and VPCs) and software-defined networking that allows for connectivity across the enterprise platforms  
  • Ability to design Fault Tolerant platforms and implement Failover and Recovery Strategies 
  • Skilled in DevOps and modern CI/CD methodologies and tools 
  • Automating cloud orchestration with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to scale services 
  • Experience with Cloud-native development frameworks and tools e.g. VPC, Lambda, SNS   
  • Understanding of modern cloud scalability to right-size resources to meet platforms computing needs 
  • Analytics and KPI usage to continuously evolve and improve Cloud Platforms 
  • Knowledgeable of modern cloud architecture and holistic developer experience.  

Soft Skills 

  • Ability to train and develop mid-senior level engineers 
  • Strong understanding of mission-critical environments 
  • Ability to advise technical and non-technical stakeholders on Cloud Strategy and solutions 
  • Strong problem solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills 

 
Tools 

  • Public Cloud Services: AWS  
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform, CloudFormation, JSON, YAML, and ARM Templates 
  • Programing/Scripting: Shell Script, Python, PHP, JavaScript, Perl, Ruby, and AWS step functions 
  • OS: Linux 
  • DevOps Practices: Continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD)  
  • Networking: Understanding cloud network architecture, VPCs, and load balancing 
  • Security: Implementing security best practices, access control, and data encryption 
  • Compliance: Adhering to industry regulations and compliance standards 

This position is designated as sensitive and requires the incumbent to undergo an initial background investigation and periodic re-screenings based on role sensitivity and company requirements. Employees in sensitive positions are required to fulfill a mandatory absence of 10 consecutive business days per calendar year, in alignment with risk management and operational integrity standards.
